MIRA-seq for DNA methylation analysis of CpG islands AIM To develop a reliable method for whole genome analysis of DNA methylation. MATERIALS & METHODS Genome-scale analysis of DNA methylation includes affinity-based approaches such as enrichment using methyl-CpG-binding proteins. One of these methods, the methylated-CpG island recovery assay (MIRA), is based on the high affinity of the MBD2b-MBD3L1 complex for CpG-methylated DNA. Here we provide a detailed description of MIRA and combine it with next generation sequencing platforms (MIRA-seq). RESULTS We assessed the performance of MIRA-seq and compared the data with whole genome bisulfite sequencing.
